episodes.title: Brethren Church denies coordinating election campaign
episodes.description:
The Plymouth Brethren has defended its church at a parliamentary hearing investigating campaigning at the last federal election.

While hundreds of members were publicly supporting the Liberal Party, the church has flatly denied it was organised from the top.
